rules.body: Pirate’s Rebellion space requirement is unverified. Obtain a current approved specification before including a size.
Prepaid events use 40% deposit and 60% on arrival. These payment terms do not establish a pay-per-play revenue split.
WYO Bounce Bash has a context-specific 50/50 arrangement. Verify its actual agreement, event year, and split direction before use. Never generalize it to other customers.
A 30-day promotional offer starts on the actual send date. Preserve existing and manually set follow-ups.

Certificates for periods after June renewal are unavailable until renewal. Verify the exact renewal day and current coverage. Sample COIs and historical contracts never establish universal current coverage.
Foam Party is a $3,500 add-on with one shared pool/resource and a separate team. Verify availability and applicability to the customer before making an offer.
Use warm, compact branded HTML and no em dash in customer emails. Verify current package/template links from the app.

Before commercial output, check complete history, incoming and sent email, attachments, contacts, dates, calendar and applicable agreements. Conflicting or unavailable sources require clarification, not invented terms.
